column1: # Italiano (it): this fork's own rows, for the AI assistant, concept maps, the wiki and Google Drive (M13).
# Same columns and escapes as craft-i18n's locales/it/pdfcraft.tsv: context <TAB> English <TAB> translation.
# crates/ui-egui/build.rs adds each row the pinned craft-i18n checkout lacks (by context and English) to
# the Italian PdfCraft catalog; a row craft-i18n already has keeps craft-i18n's translation.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean room: written from the plain meaning of the English text; AI-assisted, not separately
